findings.current: That day in Gansu, when a battle like this one had raged, Sama Pyo had returned after seeing his father’s final moments and asked me that question.
findings.defect: “Seeing” loses that Sama Pyo stayed with his father through his final moments.
findings.rationale: 아비의 최후를 지키고 describes remaining with his father at the end, not merely witnessing it.
findings.replacement: That day in Gansu, when a battle like this one had raged, Sama Pyo had returned from staying with his father through his final moments and asked me that question.
findings.source: 오늘과 같은 혈전이 벌어졌던 감숙성에서의 그날, 아비의 최후를 지키고 되돌아온 사마표의 물음에 나는 망설임 없이 대답했었다.

findings.current: Even the moment she’d fussed that the moon was bright tonight, then fallen silent at the unexpected question.
findings.defect: The draft assigns Taekyung’s fussing and silence to the woman who asked the question.
findings.rationale: The narrator recalls his own response; the surrounding lines identify her question and his subsequent answer.
findings.replacement: Even when I made a pointless fuss about how bright the moon was that night, then fell silent at her unexpected question.
findings.source: 오늘따라 달이 밝다며 괜한 호들갑을 떨고, 예상치 못했던 물음에 침묵하던 때에도.

findings.defect: Repeating “Captain” without a change loses Mujin’s self-correction to a more respectful address.
findings.rationale: 조장님 adds deference to 조장; the correction is the point of the line.
findings.replacement: *“I’ll follow your orders. Captain—no, Captain, sir.”*

findings.current: Dazzling flames swallowed the enemies whole.
findings.defect: Drops the established rendering of 광염.
findings.rationale: The supplied glossary binds 광염 to “light-flames.”
findings.replacement: Dazzling light-flames swallowed the enemies whole.

findings.current: I stabbed, pulled, and twisted through everything that stood in my way.
findings.defect: “Pulled through” obscures the spear’s withdrawal and makes the sequence hard to picture.
findings.rationale: 찌르고, 뽑고, 비틀었다 gives a sequence of stabbing, pulling out, and twisting.
findings.replacement: I stabbed through everything in my way, pulled my spear free, and twisted it.
findings.source: 나는 막아서는 모든 것을 찌르고, 뽑고, 비틀었다.

findings.defect: The System notice retains square brackets around the effect name.
findings.rationale: The binding System-panel format prohibits enclosing UI terms in square brackets.
findings.replacement: **Status Effect:** Final Rally has been applied.

findings.replacement: Final Rally is an act of divine mercy, a testament to human will, and a candle by which you may reflect on the life you have lived. Though its flame burns only briefly, that instant of light will shine so brightly that even death may be forgotten.

summary: The draft changes who spoke in a key memory, loses Sama Pyo’s role at his father’s death, and flattens an honorific correction. Several System panels also retain brackets prohibited by the binding format.
